category_name: To someone wearing a new garment
title: To someone wearing a new garment - Hisn al-Muslim 7
translation: May Allah replace it when it is worn out.
reference: Abu Dawud 4/41. See also Al-Albani Sahih Abu Dawud 2/760
tags: To someone wearing a new garment

category_name: To someone wearing a new garment
title: To someone wearing a new garment - Hisn al-Muslim 8
arabic: اِلبَـس جَديـداً وَعِـشْ حَمـيداً وَمُـتْ شهيداً
transliteration: Ilbas jadīdan, wa `ish ḥamīdan, wa mut shahīdan
translation: Put on new clothes, live a praise-worthy life and die as a martyr.
reference: Ibn Majah 2/1178, Al-Baghawi 12/41. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/275
tags: To someone wearing a new garment
